why_choose_us.title: The cleanup is part of the job
why_choose_us.description: Read our Google reviews and the same thing keeps surfacing. "Clean up was unbelievable, you would not have even known they were here." "Cleaned up nicely after completing the job." "Great job cleaning up afterwards." Three different homeowners, unprompted. Nails left in the lawn is the number one complaint about roofers anywhere — it is not a complaint we get.

why_choose_us.title: Most roofs go on in a day
why_choose_us.description: A full tear-off and reroof on a typical Scranton home is a one-day job for our crew. Homeowners tell us the same thing afterwards: the roof was finished quickly, and the estimate came back fast enough that nobody had to chase us for a number.

why_choose_us.title: Osman is on the job, not just on the paperwork
why_choose_us.description: Quality Roofing Express is independent and family owned. Customers name Osman personally in their reviews, and one homeowner has had us back for a third and fourth roof across five years — his own house, then his son's. Pennsylvania issues no roofing license to check, so that kind of repeat business is the credential that actually means something.

why_choose_us.title: Winter does not stop us
why_choose_us.description: Ice dams and melt-refreeze leaks show up in January, which is exactly when a lot of contractors stop answering the phone. We work through the NEPA winter and we are reachable seven days a week — 7am to 7pm Monday through Friday, 8am to 7pm Saturday, and Sunday mornings.
